summary: Typosquat of @tailwindcss/forms with obfuscated on-chain C2 dropper executed on require
details: The package name typosquats @tailwindcss/forms and src/index.js bundles a verbatim copy of that plugin as cover alongside a heavily obfuscated payload (obfuscator.io-style string-array _0x1e16 with 295 entries and hundreds of decoder wrappers). At import time (main = src/index.js), the payload reconstructs hostnames and Node builtins from the string array and reaches out to an Ethereum RPC endpoint (h.drpc.org / ethereum-rpc, eth_blockNumber) and an Etherscan-style txlist API (module=account&action=txlist) to retrieve attacker-controlled data from on-chain storage. The decoded code paths pull in node:https, node:child_process, node:url and createGunzip, then dynamically assign to global[...], which is the canonical on-chain-C2 fetch-decode-execute pattern producing remote code execution on any developer or build system that installs or imports the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
